Commentary.Commentary: Hmmm... 320 to win then. We witnessed one of the worst bowling displays by the Windies of the tournament. Would that propel to see their best batting effort? Will Australia be able to defend this total on a good pitch with a small boundary? Stay tuned for the run chase.

Lachlan Hearne is down for a chat. Says that during his partnership with Cooper Connolly, they talked about getting to the 40th over and then take it from there. Says his partner was very mature considering his age as he is just 16-years old. Adds that the outfield is pretty quick and the ground is small too, but they are gonna back themselves to win this game.

What went wrong with the West Indies? Probably their worst performance of the tournament with the ball. The fielding was lackluster and the bowling was even more so. Only Jayden Seales was able to exert some control early on while Matthew Patrick picked up 3 wickets keeping a stump-to-stump line. The Australians tried to line him up but because of his accuracy, they could not quite get hold of him.

Cooper Connolly, in particular, was very severe on the bowlers. He started to bat in 5th gear right from the offset and pummeled the West Indians who were nowhere near their best today. Lachlan Hearne played a supportive knock but ensured that the run rate never dipped.

The score made by Davies might seem very less - 39 from 38 balls - but it gave Australia some much-needed impetus. The Kangaroos lost two wickets of set batsmen in skipper Harvey and Davies - in the span of 14 balls - but in came Hearne and Connolly. The duo continued the counter-attack and smashed 101 for the 5th wicket, in just 92 balls.

Three half centurions and 6 batsmen who got starts. But the innings of Oliver Davies was what put this innings into perspective. He came when Liam Scott was dismissed in the 21st over and normally, one would have thought that Australia would consolidate their position. But not this man. He was out on a mission, not to let the Windies fight back and cut loose.

Boy oh boy - have Australia saved their best for the last? This performance certainly seems to suggest that. 319 is no mean task and this will require the Windies to play out of their skins. A perfect batting display, as one can see.
Good length ball on middle and off, pushed down towards mid off for a single. AUSTRALIA FINISH THEIR INNINGS ON 319/8.
Todd Murphy is the next batsman in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Kevlon Anderson takes the catch and Sangha loses his wicket in search of a final flurry. Full and on off by James, Sangha looks to loft this one over mid off but mistimes his shot. Anderson there takes the catch and Australia lose another one. However, more importantly, a dot ball and that is what the Windies needed.
FOUR! Superb innovation! Length ball down the leg side, Sangha shuffles across and paddles this over the fine leg fielder for a boundary.
Length ball outside off, Sangha looks to pull at this ball but misses it completely.

OUT! RUN OUT! Sully had to go for the second there but is found just short of his crease. Back of a length ball on off, Sully looks to go over the man at cover-point who is inside the circle and just about clears him. The ball goes towards the man in the deep, Nedd, who mops it up and throws the ball at the keeper's end. The keeper, Julien, whips the bails off in a flash. The leg umpire refers it upstairs and the replays show that Sully is short of his crease. He walks back after a very useful cameo.
Run out check sent upstairs.
On the pads, flicked towards mid-wicket for a single.
Short ball on middle and leg, angling in. Sully looks to pull but misses. The keeper dives to his left and the batters steal a couple of byes as the keeper fumbles.
Patrick Rowe is the new batsman in.

OUT! CAUGHT AND BOWLED! Cooper Connolly departs after a brilliant innings and he along with Hearne have put the Aussies in a commanding position here. Short ball on middle, Connolly looks to pull but gets a top edge on this one. Young says it is his and walks across to the left of the stumps at the non-striker's end and takes the catch to send Connolly packing.
Bouncer just outside off, Sully looks to pull but misses and the batters steal a bye.
FOUR! Back of a length ball on middle, this time Sully rocks back and pulls this behind square on the leg side for a boundary.
Full ball on off, pushed towards cover for a single.
FOUR! Smashed down the ground! Full ball on the leg pole line, Connolly smashes this one down the ground over mid on for a boundary.
Flatter and wide outside off, Sully looks to cut but misses.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Tossed up on middle, flicked towards mid-wicket for one. 300 up for Australia.

SIX! Just wide and just over! Good effort in the deep! Another shortish delivery on middle and off, Connolly rocks back and smashes this one aerially towards wide long on. Anderson from long on runs to his left and dives but cannot get a hand to it and the ball goes over for a flat maximum.
Good running! A shortish ball on middle, Connolly goes back and pulls this one towards square leg for a couple.
Floated on middle and off, Sully drives this one down the ground towards long on for one.
Ashmead Nedd to bowl out. 9-0-49-1 are his figures so far.
Full ball on off, pushed towards cover for a single and Sully will keep strike. 10 runs come off the over.
FOUR! West Indies are not learning from their mistakes here. Back of a length ball on middle and leg, Sully rocks back and smashes this one through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Another short ball on middle, again this is pulled towards square leg for one.
Back of a length ball on middle, Connolly pulls this one in front of square leg for a couple.
Full ball on off, driven towards mid off for a single.
Length ball on off, played towards point for a single.
Sully looks to make room and slash at this length ball outside off but misses out.
Back of a length ball on middle, pulled towards square leg for a single.

Superb running here! Good length ball on off, Connolly drives this one towards sweeper cover. Sully completes the first and takes off for the second in a flash and the batters complete the two runs easily.
Full ball on off, driven through covers for a single.
On the pads of Connolly, he flicks this one towards mid-wicket for a single.
Connor Sully is the next batsman in.

OUT! CAUGHT! The partnership has finally been broken but one can say it has already done the damage. Hearne holes out and Seales gets a well-deserved wicket. Back of a length ball on middle, Hearne looks to attack Seales and looks to pull. The ball goes off the top edge towards deep square leg where Nedd takes the catch. This wicket can easily decrease the final total of the Aussies by 10 runs as Hearne was going superbly.
Played to the mid-wicket region by the batsman. One run added to the total.

The 100-run stand is up between Connolly and Hearne! This has been a brilliant show of batting by these youngsters. Connolly brings up this milestone as he flicks this good length ball towards mid-wicket for a single.
Full ball on off, pushed towards mid off for a single.
Length ball wide outside off, Connolly guides this one down to third man for one.
Just short! Length ball wide outside off, Connolly looks to cut but gets a faint edge on this one. The ball goes towards the keeper but falls just in front of him as he dives forward.
Back of a length ball on middle, pulled towards mid-wicket for a single.
Yorker on middle and leg, Connolly does well to jam it out back towards the bowler. 17 runs off the over. A huge one this for the Aussies.

FOUR! Just wide! Good shot by Connolly though! Full length ball wide outside off, Connolly opens the face of the bat and looks to guide this one past third man. The ball is in the air momentarily but it is wide of Simmonds at short third man and it races away to the fence.
FOUR! Connolly is attacking here. Seals has no answer to it. Length ball outside off and Connolly creams the drive through covers and fetches himself a boundary.
FOUR! Full and outside off, Connolly just gets on the front foot and drives the ball through covers for a boundary.
Short ball on middle, Hearne pulls it towards deep square leg and gets a run.

MISFIELD AND FOUR! Seales goes full and outside off, Hearne drives it down the ground through mid off where the fielder misfields and the ball goes underneath him towards the long off fence for a boundary.
SIX! Beautiful shot to bring up the 250 for Australia! Full ball on off, Connolly has just lofted this one over the cover region and it goes into the stands.
Short ball on middle, pulled towards the backward square leg region for a single. This brings up the half ton for Lachlan Hearne and he will be looking to shift gears from here.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Another back of a length ball, pulled towards mid-wicket for one.
Back of a length ball on middle, pulled towards square leg for a single.
Full ball on middle and off, pushed towards the man at mid off.
FOUR! Connolly plays a pull shot to this short delivery on middle. The ball has crossed the ropes at mid-wicket.

Back of a length ball on middle, Hearne looks to pull but the ball goes off the top edge towards backward square leg inside the circle. The ball lands safely as there is no one there and the batters pick up a single.
FOUR! Driven away! What a shot! Full ball on middle and off, Hearne drives this one down the ground through mid on for a boundary.
Good length ball on middle and off, pushed down towards long off and the batters take a couple.
Wide! Way wide outside off, Hearne does not make any contact.
Length ball on middle and off, defended off the back foot by the batsman.

Slight confusion but in the end no damage done! Bouncer on middle and leg, Connolly looks to pull but gets a top edge which goes towards third man. The batters take a single but Connolly wants the second. However, he is sent back in time and only one run comes off it.
Bouncer on middle and off, pulled towards mid-wicket for a single.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. They pick up a single.
Good length ball on off, pushed down to long off for a couple.
Back of a length ball on the body, Hearne looks to defend but the ball hits his hand and bounces onto the turf.
Full ball on off, this one is lofted over the cover region for a single.
On the pads, Hearne flicks this one towards mid-wicket for a single.
Powerplay 3 is underway! A maximum of 5 fielders are now allowed outside the circle until the end of the innings.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Back of a length ball wide outside off, Hearne cuts this one towards deep point and the batters take a single.
Full ball on off, pushed towards cover.
Another one on the pads, flicked towards square leg for one now. This also brings up the 50-run stand between these two and the Aussies would like to finish with a flurry from here on in.
On the pads this time, flicked towards mid-wicket for a single.
Wide! Down the leg side, Hearne looks to flick but misses.
Outside off, played towards the man at point and the batters take one.
Joshua James is back on.
Length ball outside off, Connolly looks to defend but the ball goes off the outside edge through the slip region. The man in the deep at third man cuts it off and the batters take one.
Length ball outside off, played towards point.
Length ball on middle and off, Connolly defends this one off the back foot.
Full ball on middle and off, Hearne defends this one towards mid on for a single.
FOUR! Flicked away! Good length ball angling into Hearne, the batter prods forward and flicks this one through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Good length ball around middle and off, Hearne defends it back towards the bowler.
Floated delivery on off, pushed down towards long off for a single.
FOUR! Floated delivery on middle and off, Hearne gets down on one knee and plays the sweep shot behind square leg for a boundary.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
FOUR! Flatter delivery outside off, Hearne rocks back and cuts this one towards backward point for a boundary.
Floated on off, Hearne goes back and defends.
Flatter delivery on off, played towards the man at point.
Full ball on off, pushed towards the cover region for a couple. 9 runs off the over and the Aussies are scoring runs at a very good pace.

Hearne just about gets away with it here! Good length ball just around off, angling in. Hearne looks to push this one towards the off side but the ball goes off the inside edge past the leg pole towards fine leg and the batters take a single.
On the pads, played towards the mid-wicket fielder.
FOUR! Cut away! Back of a length ball outside off, Hearne goes onto the back foot and cuts it through the backward point for a boundary.

Length ball on middle and leg, Hearne rocks back and pulls this one towards square leg. Beckford in the deep runs to his right and cuts it off but fumbles and that allows the batters to take two easily.
Full ball on middle and off, defended back towards the bowler.
Ramon Simmonds is back on. 4-0-29-1 are his figures so far.
FOUR! Floated outside off, Connolly rocks back and cuts this one through backward point for a boundary.
On the pads, defended towards the leg side.
Another play and a miss! This time Nedd makes the ball go away from Connolly. He looks to cut but misses the ball completely.
Floated on off, pushed towards the man at cover.
Beauty! Tossed up just outside off, Connolly looks to push this one towards the off side. The ball turns in and sneaks through the bat and pad.
Flatter one on middle and leg, Hearne pushes this one towards mid on for a single.
Ashmead Nedd is back on. 7-0-35-1 so far from him.
Length ball way outside off, Connolly leaves that one alone. The Aussies looking to safely play away the bowling of Seales.
Length ball on middle and off, Connolly defends this one back towards the bowler.
Back of a length ball on middle, defended towards cover.
What a delivery! Bouncer around off, at 135 kph. Connolly does well to spot that bouncer early and drop his gloves to let that ball go the keeper.
Another one on the hips, Hearne pushes this towards wide mid on for a single.
A length ball on the pads, played back towards the bowler.
Floated ball on off, pushed to covers by the batter.
Tossed up around off, Connolly drives it to mid off.
Flatter and on off, Hearne pulls it towards deep mid-wicket and gets a single.
Floated ball on off, pushed towards mid off.

A huge appeal for LBW but turned down. Patrick tosses one up on leg and middle and the ball spins away. Hearne goes for the sweep but misses it. The ball raps him on the pads  and the bowler raises an appeal to which the umpire shakes his head.
Floated ball on off, pushed back towards mid on.
Hearne has worked it off his pads behind square on the leg side. They pick up a single.
Good length ball outside off, Connolly looks to come down the track and play the cover drive but the ball goes off the outside edge down towards third man for a single.
Loud appeal but turned down! Length ball around the leg pole line, Hearne looks to flick but misses.
Another one on off, guided down towards third man for a single.
Another one outside off, Hearne guides this one towards third man for a single.
Length ball on off, punched towards cover off the back foot towards cover off a single.
DRINKS! Since the last Drinks break, West Indies have stormed back into the game.
The batsman has driven it straight down the ground.
FOUR! Swept and Swept well. Hearne sweeps it through square leg and gets a boundary.
Flighted ball on off, Hearne drives it through covers and gets a couple.
Tossed up on middle, Connolly works it towards mid-wicket and takes a single.
Floated ball on off, Connolly dances down the track and plays it to the bowler.
Tossed up around off, pushed towards covers.
Good length ball just around the off pole line, Connolly chips this one over the bowler's head. The man from mid on runs to his right and cuts it off as the batters take a single.
Bouncer on middle and leg, Connolly ducks under it.
Back of a length ball on middle, Connolly goes back and defends.
Good length ball outside off, guided towards third man for a single.
Full ball on off, played back towards the bowler.
Length ball outside off, Hearne plays this one towards the man at point off the front foot.
Floated ball on middle, Connolly plays it to mid on.
Cooper Connolly is the new batsman in.

OUT! CLEANED UP! Australia living by the sword and dying by it! Patrick has his third of the innings and is bowling superbly. Davies once again goes to innovate but this time he fails. Flatter one on the off pole line, Oliver goes for the paddle scoop once again. This time the ball goes past his attempted shot and crashes into the off pole. Oliver Davies was looking well set and Australia would have wanted him to stay in the middle but that is not the case as he takes the long walk back.
FOUR! Innovative! Flighted ball on off, Davies paddle scoops it over the keeper and the ball finds the fence at fine leg.
Tossed up once again on off, Davies blocks it off the front foot once again.
Floated ball on off, Davies blocks it by coming on the front foot.
Tossed up on middle, Hearne tucks it to square leg for a single.

FOUR! A boundary to end the 29th over! Back of a length ball on middle again, this time Davies pulls towards wide long on, in the gap, and the ball goes into the fence on the bounce. 12 runs off the over!
Full ball on middle and off, played back towards Young.
Length ball outside off, Hearne cuts this one towards the point region and changes ends.
Another back of a length ball on middle, Davies this time manages just a single as it is pulled towards the man at deep mid-wicket.
SIX! Hammered and smashed! Back of a length ball on middle, Davies rocks back and smashes this ball over the mid-wicket region for a biggie.
Young starts with a wonderful yorker, on the off pole line. Davies does well to jam it out.
Nyeem Young is back on. 2-0-19-0 are his figures so far.
Tossed up outside off, Hearne looks to drive it through the off side but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Floated ball on off, blocked off the front foot towards the bowler.
Lachlan Hearne is the next batsman in.

OUT! BOWLED'EM! Harvey is confused with what has happened there! Patrick tosses one up on the off pole line. Harvey goes onto the back foot looking to steer it down towards third man. The ball comes in with the angle and sneaks through the gap between the bat and pad to disturb the woodwork behind. 3 wickets so far and all have been taken by spinners. The skipper departs and his sorry tournament with the bat ends in further misery.
Flatter and on middle, Davies flicks it towards mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! 10 from the two balls so far. Shorter and wide outside off, Davies cuts it through cover-point and finds the fence for a boundary.
SIX! Davies is playing spin to perfection. Oliver just gets to the pitch of the ball and lofts it cleanly over covers and the ball clears the fence for a biggie.
WIDE! Patrick dishes one down the leg side, Davies looks to sweep it but misses it . The keeper takes it.
Tossed up delivery on middle, Davies plays a sweep through mid-wicket. The fielder in the deep does well to stop it. The batsmen cross ends.
Floated delivery on middle, Davies keeps it out.
Flighted delivery on off, Harvey punches it through mid off for a run.
Short again and outside off, Davies cuts it hard through point for a single.
Short delivery on off, Harvey makes room and cuts it through point. The batsmen take a single.
Tossed up delivery outside off, Harvey leaves it alone.
Shorter and outside off, Harvey cuts it through point and retains the strike.
Floated ball outside off, Harvey makes room and looks to drive it through covers. The ball takes the inside edge and hits the pads in the process. Lucky that it did not go onto hit the stumps.

Tossed up ball on off, Davies once again walks down the track and lofts it over mid off. He fails to time it as the ball goes towards the long off region. The fielder there runs towards it but fails to judge it. The ball falls well in front of the fielder and then rolls towards him. A run taken.
Full ball on middle, Davies once again flicks it to the leg side and finds the fielder there.
Tossed up on middle, Davies flicks it to mid-wicket.
FOUR! Davies puts on his dancing shoes and takes on the spinner. Patrick tosses one outside off, Davies lofts it over point for a boundary.
Floated ball on off, Davies gets to the pitch of it and drives it towards covers for a single.
Fuller ball on off, defended off the back foot towards covers.
Tossed up on off, driven through mid on, off the inside half of the bat for a run.
FOUR! Classy! Flatter and on middle, Harvey goes down on one knee and sweeps it cleanly through square leg. Simmonds in the deep fails to cut it off as the ball goes to the fence.
Tossed up on off, Harvey pushes the ball to covers.
Tossed up on off, Harvey blocks it off the back foot towards covers.
Full and on the pads, tucked towards mid-wicket for a run.
Full and on off, Davies comes down the track and pushes the ball towards mid off where the fielder misfields to allow a run.
Full and outside off, driven to covers.
Tossed up ball outside off, Davies defends it off the back foot.
Full and outside off, Davies drives it through covers. The fielder from sweeper cover does well to mop it up. A couple taken.
Flatter and on off, defended towards the bowler.
Flatter one on off, Harvey gets a bottom edge of the bat on that one as he looks to cut.
Flatter one on off, Harvey goes back and defends.
Flatter one outside off, left alone.
Davies dances down the track and pushes this one towards mid-wicket for a single.
Floated on middle and off, pushed back towards the bowler.
Down the leg side, Davies looks to flick but misses. Davies is hit on the pads.
Flatter and outside off, driven towards long off for a run.
Loopy delivery on off, pushed to the off side off the front foot.
Tossed up on middle and leg, flicked towards mid-wicket.
Tossed up ball on off, pushed back to the bowler.
Short and spinning away, outside off, Harvey pulls it towards mid-wicket and gets a run.
Tossed up on off, Harvey blocks it off the back foot.
The batsman shoulders arms to let that one through.
Wide! Down the leg side, Davies looks to flick this one but misses. Wide signalled!
Tossed up delivery on middle, played back towards the bowler.
Another one on the pads, worked towards the man at mid-wicket.
On the pads, worked towards square leg.
Flatter one on middle, worked towards the leg side.

OUT! TIMBER! The leg pole goes for a toss and Liam Scott is out of here. Ashmead Nedd has his man. Both the openers are now back in the hut. Flatter and full ball on middle and off, angling into Scott. Liam goes onto the back foot and looks to defend but that is the wrong decision as the ball is too full to do that. Scott misses the ball and the leg pole is uprooted. Can the West Indies make further inroads from here? Oliver Davies comes out to replace Liam Scott in the middle.
Flatter one on middle and off, played back towards the bowler.
Flatter one outside off, Harvey looks to go down and cut but misses.
This time Scott manages to change ends as he pushes this one down the ground towards long on for a single.
Flatter one on middle and off, pushed towards the man at mid on.
Another one floated on off, driven towards the man at cover.
Floated on off, pushed towards the man at cover.
Full and on off, pushed towards mid off and gets a single.
FOUR! Second boundary off the over. Tossed up on middle and leg, Scott flicks it off the pads towards fine leg and fetches a boundary.
Flatter and on off, blocked off the front foot towards covers.

Harvey waits on the back foot to play it late. Nedd tosses one up outside off and makes it to spin away. Harvey there cuts it late and gets it past the cover and point fielder. Both the fielders chase the ball to the fence and succeed to keep it in play but not before the batsmen take three.
Tossed up ball on off, Harvey defends it off the front foot towards covers.
FOUR! Tossed up ball outside off, Harvey punches the ball off the back foot and gets it through covers for a boundary.
Full and on off, Harvey drives it towards mid off and takes a single.
Full and outside off, Harvey drives it through covers and gets a couple.
Floated ball on off, blocked off the back foot.
Tossed up and around off, Scott pushes the ball towards mid off and takes a run.
Full and outside off, Scott pushes it to covers.
BEATEN! Tossed up ball outside off, Scott looks to block it but the ball sneaks away past the outside edge and the keeper collects it.
Floated on off, Harvey guides this one towards the man at first slip on the bounce.
Another flatter one on off, pushed towards point. The fielder there misfields and that allows the batters to take a single.
Flatter on off, pushed towards the man at cover.
FOUR! Up and over! Scott is looking really good here! Tossed up delivery on middle and off, Scott comes down the ground and lofts it straight over the bowler's head for a boundary towards long off.
Another one floated around off, pushed towards the man at mid off.
Floated ball on off, pushed back towards the bowler.
Full and angled on middle and leg, Harvey defends it towards the leg side.
Mackenzie Harvey, the skipper, is the new man in.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! The opening partnership is broken, just one short of the 100-run stand. Fanning's stay at the crease has been ended. Patrick tosses one up outside off, Fanning gets sucked into defending it. The ball turns in and catches the outside edge of Fanning's blade on its way to the keeper. Leonardo Julien takes a good catch and starts to celebrate immediately. West Indies have finally struck after a long time! Can they capitalise on this opening?
Scott lunges forward to this tossed up ball and drives it through covers for a run.
Full ball on off, Scott defends it back to the bowler.
Short ball on middle and leg, Scott pulls it towards mid-wicket.
Floated ball on middle and leg, Scott tucks it towards mid-wicket.
Spin from both ends now as Matthew Patrick is introduced from the other end.
Flighted ball on off, pushed towards covers and a run is taken.
Full and on middle, Fanning drives it towards long on and gets a run.
Tossed up ball on off, Fanning defends it from within the crease.
Flatter and on middle, Fanning sweeps it fine towards fine leg and gets a couple.
Floated ball on off, Fanning defends it off the front foot towards covers.
Flatter and outside off, Fanning cuts it past point. The fielder there gives the chase and saves a certain boundary. A couple taken.

Drinks Break! It has been an excellent opening hour for Australia! They have played some good aggressive strokes but have rode their luck as well. The West Indies bowlers have tried to keep it tight but the Australian batters have done extremely well to score at a good rate. The West Indies side have not been able to pick up a wicket as they have failed to take their chances. The opening pair are amidst a 92-run stand and it will be interesting to see what happens during the middle passage of the game. Also, spin for the first time as Ashmead Nedd is introduced into the attack.
Beaten! James makes a good comeback as he bowls a good length in the corridor outside off. Scott looks to have a poke at it but misses as the ball whizzes past the outside edge.
FOUR! 50 for Scott! He has made the West Indies side pay for dropping his catch! He gets to this milestone by cutting a ball outside off through the backward point region and gets a boundary.
FOUR! Cut away! Back of a length ball outside off, Scott cuts this through the point region and the ball races away to the fence beating the fielder who is chasing it.
Length ball on middle and off, pushed towards cover and Fanning changes ends.
FOUR! Good shot by Fanning! Full ball wide outside off, Fanning stretches his arms and lofts this one over cover-point for a boundary.
Full ball on the pads, flicked towards the mid-wicket region and the batters change ends.
Full and angled on middle, flicked towards mid-wicket and Scott retains the strike for the next over as he takes a single.

FOUR! Three in a row! Short ball on middle and off, Scott looks to pull once again but this time he fails to middle it and gets a top edge. The ball flies over the keeper and into the fine leg fence for a boundary.
FOUR! Second one from the over. Scott is on fire. Young goes short and on middle, Scott pulls it handsomely through mid-wicket and gets another boundary.
FOUR! Full and outside off, Scott once again gets on the front foot and creams the drive through covers and fetches a boundary.
Length ball around off, Scott blocks it off the front foot towards covers.
Length ball outside off, Scott defends it off the front foot and towards covers.
BEATEN! Length ball outside off, Fanning looks to play at it but misses it again. How many times have we seen that today? Well, ran out of fingers for that!
Length ball outside off, left alone with ease.
Scott drives this length ball outside off through point for a single.
Length ball outside off, Scott blocks it off the back foot towards covers.

EDGED AND FOUR! This time it is Scott who gets an edge. James bowls one on a length and outside off, Scott looks to defend it but gets an outside edge and the ball runs towards the third man fence. The fielder from deep point runs towards his left but he fails to cut it off.
Length ball angled into middle, flicked towards mid-wicket.
Back of a length ball on middle and off, Scott defends this one off the back foot towards the off side and takes a quick single. He will retain strike for the next over.
Wide! Down the leg side, Scott looks to go after it but misses. Wided!
Length ball on middle and off, pushed towards cover off the back foot by Scott.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Back of a length ball on middle and off, defended by Scott.

MISFIELD AND FOUR! That is a simple take but Daniel Beckford has made a mess of it. Length ball outside off, Scott cuts this one off the back foot towards point. Beckford runs to his right and gets down to collect the ball but it goes between his legs and into the fence. Easy runs for Australia after some tight bowling relieving all the pressure.
Good length ball on off, pushed towards the man at cover by Scott.
Powerplay 2 is signalled. Maximum of 4 fielders will be allowed outside the 30-yard circle till the 40th over. Also, Nyeem Young is on.
Full and outside off, Fanning drives it straight to the man at covers.

EDGED AND FOUR! Lucky escape for Fanning! He lives to die another day. James bowls one on a length and outside off, Fanning throws his bat at it as he looks to drive it through covers. The ball shoots off the surface and catches the outside edge of the bat. The ball goes between the keeper and first slip. Both look confused as to who is going for the catch. Leonardo Julien, the keeper, finally goes for it but till then the ball already went past him and into the third man fence for a boundary.

Full and on middle, Scott flicks it towards mid-wicket and gets to the other end. 50-run stand is also up between the two. It is raised in quick time and this is a solid foundation for the batters to come in next.
Full and outside off, Scott  looks to drive but the ball goes past the outside edge and the keeper collects it.
FOUR! Handsomely driven! Full and slightly overpitched this time. Scott leans on it and drives it straight down the ground past the bowler and into the long off fence for a boundary.
Full and outside off, Scott slaps it straight to covers.
Joshua James is on.
Play and a miss again! Back of a length ball on off, Fanning looks to play at it off the back foot but the ball pitches and moves away as it beats the outside edge of the bat.
Third time in this over that a length ball has been played to the point fielder by Fanning. Seales is looking like a class act!
Outside off, good length ball, pushed towards point.
Another play and a miss! Good length ball on middle and off, angling away after pitching. Fanning looks to put bat on ball but plays inside the line of the delivery.
Good length ball on off, pushed towards the man at point off the front foot.
Wide! Back of a length ball down the leg side, Fanning leaves it alone. Wide signalled!
Full ball on off, pushed towards the man at cover by Fanning.
SIX! Hammered! Short and on middle, Scott rocks on the back foot and pulls it handsomely over deep square leg. The ball just about manages to clear the fence.
Length ball on middle, flicked away towards mid-wicket.
WIDE! Length ball but down the leg side. Scott looks to flick it but fails to get anything behind the shot. Wided by the umpire.
Full and angled on middle and leg, Fanning flicks it to mid-wicket and gets a run.
BEATEN ONCE AGAIN! Fanning is finding it difficult to put bat on ball. He once again misses to get bat on ball and it goes past the outside edge.
Play and a miss! Fanning looks to get some wood behind the ball this time on this length ball but the ball moves away and goes past the outside edge.
FOUR! Excellent cover drive from Fanning! Gorgeous shot! It was a half volley and Fanning just leans on it and drives it through covers. The ball goes to the fence in no time.
Length ball on off, Scott blocks it off the back foot towards covers.
Another back of a length ball on off, Fanning pushes it towards third man and gets to the other end.
Short of a length ball on off, Fanning hops inside the crease and defends it to covers.
Fuller in length and on middle, Fanning gets on the back foot and blocks it to covers.
The physio is out in the middle. Jayden Seales looks in pain. He has taken his shoes off and is stretching his legs. Not sure what the reason for it is but this is concerning for the West Indies.
FOUR! Beautifully played. Length ball on middle and leg, Fanning just uses the pace of the bowler and flicks it over the mid-wicket fielder and the ball rolls to the fence.
BEATEN! Too close to the outside edge. Length ball on off, going away from the batsman. Fanning looks to defend it but he gets beaten once again.
Played to the point region by the batsman. They pick up a single.
A short ball, outside off, Scott looks to pull but the ball bounces and takes the top edge. It goes beyond mid-wicket and a single is taken.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Down the leg side, flicked through mid-wicket for a couple.
Landed outside off, tapped towards point for a single.
FOUR! That is a sweet shot. Full and outside off, Fanning leans and drives it through the covers! No stopping that.
WIDE. Down the leg side, Fanning looks to flick but misses. Someone appeals for a catch, even after the umpire signals a wide.
BEATEN! Another length ball around off and another play and a miss. This time Scott is the man who fails to lay wood on the ball on this defensive shot.
BEAMER! A Test match style ball. Seales bowls it in the centre of the pitch and makes it to rear up the turf. Scott does well to drop his wrists and leaves it.
Short of  a length ball around off, Fanning plays it towards third man and takes a run off the Free Hit.
FREE HIT TIME!

NO BALL! Seales oversteps here. He bowls a length ball outside off and Fanning blocks it off the back foot towards covers. A close call on the no ball here. The landing foot for Jayden Seales was close to the popping crease. Seems like some part of it was inside.
BEATEN! Fanning gets beaten for the umpteenth time. He looks to defend the ball outside off but the ball goes past the outside edge and into the mitts of the keeper.
Short of a length ball outside off, Scott hops inside the crease and taps it towards point for a single.
Full and angled on off, defended off the front foot towards mid-wicket.
A bouncer on middle, ducked under.
Landed outside off, dabbed to third man for a run.
Landed outside off, played through point for a single.
Around off, blocked from the crease.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
FOUR! That is a shot played with authority. Full and outside off, Fanning leans and drives it through point. Third man starts to chase to his left but lets it be.
Full on middle, pushed straight to mid on.
Full and outside off, Sam leans and pushes this through point. There is an opportunity for the second but the batsmen are happy with one.
A bouncer on middle, ducked under.
Outside off, left alone again.
Full and outside off, Scott leans and drives this wide of cover. Three runs taken.
Lovely bowling. Full and around off, swinging in, Fanning plays it watchfully and guides it towards point. A single taken.
A length ball, angling away, pitched outside off, left alone. Good over from Simmonds. Should have had a wicket.
Again. Gets this one to move away from the right-hander. LS chases after it but misses.
Back of a length outside off, Liam looks to force this through the line but is defeated by extra bounce.
On a good length around off, watchfully defended.

EDGED, BUT DROPPED! Scott gets a life early on. These catches need to be taken. As the saying goes, catches win matches. This time West Indies do not apply it. Simmonds goes wide outside off and tempts the batsman to go for a waft there. Scott there obliges and plays a slash only to edge it towards the slip cordon. The ball goes towards first slip, right into his bread basket but the keeper, Leonardo Julian dives to his right. He has the gloves in his hand but he cannot quite take it in front of first slip. Had he let it by, first slip would have gobbled it. But bygones are bygones now...
This is inside the wide guideline and is left alone again.
WIDE. That is a harsh call. Full and outside off, swinging away, Scott shoulders arms and the ball just about grazes the wide guideline.
Ramon Simmonds to bowl from the other end with the second new ball.
BEATEN! Another ball that lands on a length and goes away from the batter. The ball misses the outside edge as the batsmen looks to play the defensive shot.
WIDE! Short and down the leg side. Fanning lets it be.

BEATEN! Beauty of a delivery. Almost a wicket there. Seales bowls one on a fuller length and takes the ball away from the batter. Fanning looks to drive it but the ball beats the outside edge and goes to the keeper.
Australia off the mark. Seales bowls one on the pads and Scott flicks it towards deep square leg and takes a single.
Three leaves in a row. Another length ball outside off, Scott is happy to leave it.
Length ball outside off, Scott makes another leave. There is good carry to the keeper.
Seales starts with a gentle loosener outside off, Scott lets it go through to the keeper.

Done and dusted with the national anthems. The two Australian openers Liam Scott and Sam Fanning walk in to start the innings. The West Indies players are out too as they take their respective fielding positions. Jayden Seales to begin the proceedings with the ball.
We are all set to begin with as the teams line up for the National Anthems. It will be Australia's first followed by West Indies'.

Australian captain, Mackenzie Harvey, says that the challenge for his side is to try and build partnerships in the middle order. Stresses that they are alright at the start but once wickets start to fall, they struggle. But admits that they have been improving as the tournament has progressed. On his learnings from Chris Rogers and Ryan Harris, Mackenzie says that he just had a word with the as to how they approached situations when they were in trouble. Is sad to see that this will be their last game and just wants to finish well, hoping that they win. On the team changes, Harris says that Connor Sully and Todd Murphy return to the side, in place of Liam Marshall and Bradley Simpson.

West Indies Kimani Melius, says that he would look to his bowlers to pick up early wickets and put Australia under pressure. Says that he is personally disappointed with himself, as he knows he could have done a lot more. So now, hopes to do well ad end the tournament well. Informs that they have made one change - Antonio Morris has been left out for Daniel Beckford.

PITCH REPORT - Tom Moody says that the surface looks very good but due to heavy rain in the last 24 hours, the covers were on and off. So there will be moisture and help for the seamers early on. If the batsmen manage to get through the first 2 hours, they might be able to make some runs.

Australia U19 (Playing XI) - Liam Scott, Sam Fanning, Mackenzie Harvey (c), Lachlan Hearne, Oliver Davies, Cooper Connolly, Patrick Rowe (w), Tanveer Sangha, Connor Sully (In for Liam Marshall), Todd Murphy (In for Bradley Simpson), Matthew Willans.

West Indies U19 (Playing XI) - Kimani Melius (C), Leonardo Julien (WK), Kevlon Anderson, Kirk Mckenzie, Daniel Beckford (In for Antonio Morris), Matthew Patrick, Nyeem Young, Joshua James, Ashmead Nedd, Jayden Seales, Ramon Simmonds.
TOSS - It's time for the flip of the coin. Both the skipper's are out in the middle. Up goes the coin and it lands in favour of Kimani Melius. WEST INDIES  WIN THE TOSS AND WILL BOWL FIRST!

Once favourites, now playing for the 5th place playoffs. This is the irony of this gentlemen's game. West Indies, touted as one of the favourites to win the tournament (at least, as per my manager) have not even made it to the semis. They face off with Australia in a fight for the 5th spot. Both teams have had a similar run in the tournament. The only difference was the boys from the Caribbean had the better of the boys from Australia in the league clash. The lads from the Tasman have an opportunity to avenge that humiliation and end the tournament on a winning note. Whereas, West Indies would look to win against them for the second time and finish it on a high. Hello and welcome to our coverage of this game. Who will end up on the winning side? Toss and team updates in a short while.
